positive_gate.preferred: multiple target families at labelable scale with clear plan relationships

elevation_section_gate: Actual building/structural elevation or section with useful vertical structural/building geometry; reject index, notes, schedules, and detail-only sheets.
automation_prohibition: OCR/text/title/index/filename/keyword/Python may navigate but may never admit or select a sheet.
post_extraction_gate: Extracted PDF/PNG must be visually reviewed again before validated or training_ready=true.
